title: EngineError
description: The structured error value carried in a ResponseFrame's 'error' member. Errors are values: this is the only way an operation fails. Taxonomy in spec.md §10.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Open vocabulary; unknown codes are handled by category fallback (spec.md §10).

message.description: Human-readable description, not intended for programmatic dispatch.

details.description: Code-specific structured details (e.g. 'supported' for protocol-version-unsupported, 'op' for operation-unsupported).
